traffic.basis: one read of every declared input array plus one write of every declared output array, sized from the suite shape and dtype; logical interface bytes only, so neither cache-resident operands nor intermediate allocations are represented

setup_policy: fixtures, H2D, library initialization, compilation and validation outside timing
session_policy: backend process and device reused across samples
precision_policy: PyTorch TF32 disabled; JAX x64 enabled and matmul precision highest
reason: No verified single public solution-only least-squares API with the same requested outputs; native candidate APIs also return residual/rank/singular-value outputs.
